en.headline: An agent team for marketing creation.
en.intro: Built for frequent creators with limited production expertise, Qwen Create turns a campaign brief into strategy, copy, images, and video.
en.access: Region-limited access. A U.S., Mexico, Brazil, Philippines, or Indonesia IP address is required to open the product.
en.imageAlt: English Qwen Create Ad video creator workspace, with the Experts menu and Growth expert project in the sidebar
en.targetBody: For marketing creators who publish frequently, work across social platforms, and need professional-looking assets without specialist production skills.
en.overviewTitle: One brief. A coordinated agent team.
en.overviewBody: One lead agent identifies intent, plans the work, and delegates tasks to five specialists using reusable Skills and tools.

features.title: Intent & routing
features.body: Understand creator requests and invoke the appropriate agents, tools and Skills.

features.title: Platform-ready content
features.body: Connect marketing strategy with copy, imagery and video for TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.

features.title: Evaluation loop
features.body: Review model quality, planning, execution and end-to-end task success to refine workflows.

en.workflowTitle: From campaign brief to usable assets.
en.flowNote: A simplified view of the multi-agent process.

zh.headline: 一支面向营销创作的 Agent 团队。
zh.intro: 面向高频创作、专业制作能力有限的创作者，Qwen Create 将营销需求转化为策略、文案、图像与视频。
zh.role: AI 产品经理实习生 · 千问 · 2026
zh.access: 产品目前有地区限制，需要使用美国、墨西哥、巴西、菲律宾或印度尼西亚的 IP 地址访问。
zh.imageAlt: Qwen Create 英文 Ad video creator 工作台，左侧展示 Experts 菜单和 Growth expert 项目
zh.targetTitle: 高频创作，跨越多种内容形式。
zh.targetBody: 服务于需要持续产出营销内容、适配不同社交平台，又缺少专业制作技能的创作者。
targetPoints: 文案、图像与视频多形态
zh.overviewTitle: 一个需求，一支协作的 Agent 团队。
zh.overviewBody: 由主 Agent 识别意图、制定计划，并调用五个专业 Agent 及可复用 Skills、工具来执行任务。
zh.leadAgentNote: 意图识别、规划与任务分配
zh.specialistNote: 专业分工与可复用 Skills

features.title: 意图识别与调用
features.body: 理解创作者需求，决定调用哪些 Agent、工具和 Skills。

features.title: 适配社交平台
features.body: 打通营销策略、文案、图像与视频，适配 TikTok、Instagram 和 YouTube。

features.title: 评测与迭代
features.body: 从模型质量、规划、执行、端到端成功率四个维度评估工作流。

zh.workflowTitle: 从营销需求到可用素材。
